definition.question: How severe is energy-driven price and market stress for consumers and economies?
definition.low_end: Energy prices stable and low with little pass-through to headline inflation or consumer costs.
definition.high_end: Sustained extreme energy price spike driving broad inflation, de-anchored expectations, fiscal strain and demand destruction.
